bio: As you motor south down the iconic N7 highway, why not stop off in this verdant spot that boasts a shaded terrace overlooking the garden, which is blissful in fine weather? This bistronomic eatery is a pleasant alternative to the parent establishment, a renowned temple of regional gastronomy. In its younger sibling, you will sample light, unstuffy dishes presented in a series of set menus. A few guestrooms are available should you wish to relax for longer....
